context.body: Heavenly or exalted figures are addressed as accountable to the God who judges all nations.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

context.body: Judgment, exile, and the nations · Psalm 82:1–8
context.label: Canonical location

observations.body: God stands in an assembly, rebukes unjust rulers called gods, and announces that they will die like humans.
observations.label: God judges in the divine assembly: action

observations.body: The judged figures favor the wicked and fail to defend weak people; the psalm ends by asking God to judge the earth.
observations.label: God judges in the divine assembly: response

observations.body: divine assembly · gods · judge unjustly · die like men
observations.label: Words in Psalm 82:1–8

payload.posture: Read Psalm 82:1–8 as judgment, exile, and the nations evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The psalm calls the judged figures gods without making them equal to the presiding judge.
payload.title: God judges in the divine assembly
